title: Supporting Citrix App and Desktop Applications

blocks.text: Citrix App and Desktop applications are not accessible via Private Access (ZPA) when a wildcard (e.g., *.domain.com) or FQDN application (e.g., citrix.domain.com) is defined within an application segment. This is due to Citrix's default ICA file returning the IP address of the Citrix server in their data center that services the application request. Although it's possible for Private Access to access these applications using an IP address, this is not an ideal solution and is counter to our Zero Trust solution.

Instead, you should configure Citrix to return the FQDN for the servers in their data center. This enables XenApp to establish a new connection to the FQDN, which Private Access then uses to pass the service through.
To learn more about how to configure Citrix, refer to the Citrix documentation.
To learn more about application access and discovery within Private Access, see Understanding Application Access.
